description: Description: measured 2026-10-31 after the speed-up, High Power energy mode, Apple M5 Max (6 super and 12 performance cores). Throughput is C.1's v2 simulation at the box centre on discarded seeds (base 99,500,000), jobs a whole number of rounds per worker count where possible; one core is one profiled simulation (16.9 s, base 99,600,000). Batch size is one BatchedEvaluator run of C.1's model at the box centre on one core (seeds from 99,800,000); at every size the first 200 animals' trajectories were byte-identical to the 200-animal run.
